reviewMethod: Manually judged all 24 anonymous observations against the previously frozen source and usefulEditCriteria. Did not read the identity key, named reports, candidate D or new trial code during this scoring. Candidate C was reviewed in a separate prior task before this anonymous review was requested; no candidate identity is known for an observation. No model, build, or UI execution. Ratings were decided from the source/output/error pairs; this script only records those decisions and verifies their frozen criteria match.

ratingDefinitions.faithfulness: Pass requires preservation of source facts and relationships; retaining unambiguous explicit correction wording can pass source-relative faithfulness while failing useful editing. Empty filler substitution alone is not a semantic failure. Errors with no accepted output are not_assessable.
ratingDefinitions.usefulNotes: Pass requires every frozen usefulEditCriterion, with unchanged already-good controls allowed only as control-preserved. Filler-only cleanup without required independent-task separation, unresolved correction wording, and fallback all fail useful Notes.
ratingDefinitions.safe fallback: An error is returned with Original reported available; no accepted generated output is present. This is not a transformation or control success.
